items.title: Difference Between Propositional and Predicate Logic (Roman Urdu)

source_refs.note: Roman Urdu: Difference Between Propositional and Predicate Logic, with a two-column comparison table of ours (PDF 31, printed 27).

blocks.text: Propositional logic aise simple statements ke saath kaam karti hai jo ya sach hon ya jhoot. Yeh cheezon ki properties ya un ke rishte bayan nahi kar sakti. Doosri taraf predicate logic predicates aur variables istemal kar ke tafseeli statements likhti hai. Predicate logic propositional logic se zyada expressive (zyada baat bayan karne wali) aur taqatwar hai. Propositional logic samajhna aasan hai lekin us mein lachak (flexibility) kam hai. Predicate logic bohat si cheezon aur shartom ke baare mein statements likhne deti hai.
